answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 360 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the hollow. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the summit queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 332 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
